summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test, indicating potential issues that need immediate attention. Recommendations include checking for large media files, unoptimized scripts, or server-side configurations affecting the page's load time.
insights: The blog page has the shortest duration (1070ms) and load time (210.9ms), indicating that optimizing the number of requests, media file sizes, and scripts can significantly improve web performance.

Reducing the Time to First Byte (TTFB) can help decrease the overall load time. TTFB measures the duration from the user making a request to the first byte of the page being received. In this case, the homepage has the lowest TTFB (21.7ms), while the pricing page has a higher TTFB (58.9ms).

First Contentful Paint (FCP) measures the time it takes for the first piece of content to be displayed on the page. Optimizing FCP can help create a better user experience by displaying content quickly. The homepage and blog page have similar FCPs (525.8ms and 166.3ms, respectively), while the pricing page has a higher FCP (240.5ms).
